semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact Oracle identity, single-face mana cost and artifact type, and both authored ability definitions.

The controller's noncreature spell triggers one target choice while the trigger is stacked; after the Gauntlet leaves, choosing poison adds exactly one poison counter and finishes the captured trigger.
A permanent with no counters remains a legal target; resolution offers no counter-kind choice, adds none, and clears the trigger.
No trigger is created for a creature spell, an opponent's noncreature spell, or the Gauntlet after it has left the battlefield.

The two granted loyalty abilities appear on the controller's planeswalker, not the artifact, opposing planeswalker, or creature; duplicate providers occupy distinct slots but share the recipient's once-per-turn cap; provider departure and return preserve that cap, while recipient reentry creates a new incarnation with a fresh cap. The +0 ability proliferates one selected existing loyalty counter.

Eleven recipient loyalty is rejected without mutation, twelve pays the actual -12 cost, and the captured ability resolves after its planeswalker and Gauntlet leave to schedule the controller's extra turn.

Carth changes the offered +0 and -12 loyalty payments to +1 and -11; without an instant-speed permission the off-turn activation is rejected, while Teferi's actual emblem permits it over a spell. The changed costs are paid on their actual recipient planeswalkers.
